schema.content:
Table "advisor" {
  "s_ID" TEXT [pk]
  "i_ID" TEXT
}

Table "classroom" {
  "building" TEXT [pk]
  "room_number" TEXT [pk]
  "capacity" TEXT
}

Table "course" {
  "course_id" TEXT [pk]
  "title" TEXT
  "dept_name" TEXT
  "credits" TEXT
}

Table "department" {
  "dept_name" TEXT [pk]
  "building" TEXT
  "budget" TEXT
}

Table "instructor" {
  "ID" TEXT [pk]
  "name" TEXT [not null]
  "dept_name" TEXT
  "salary" TEXT
}

Table "prereq" {
  "course_id" TEXT [pk]
  "prereq_id" TEXT [pk]
}

Table "section" {
  "course_id" TEXT [pk]
  "sec_id" TEXT [pk]
  "semester" TEXT [pk]
  "year" TEXT [pk]
  "building" TEXT
  "room_number" TEXT
  "time_slot_id" TEXT
}

Table "student" {
  "ID" TEXT [pk]
  "name" TEXT [not null]
  "dept_name" TEXT
  "tot_cred" TEXT
}

Table "takes" {
  "ID" TEXT [pk]
  "course_id" TEXT [pk]
  "sec_id" TEXT [pk]
  "semester" TEXT [pk]
  "year" TEXT [pk]
  "grade" TEXT
}

Table "teaches" {
  "ID" TEXT [pk]
  "course_id" TEXT [pk]
  "sec_id" TEXT [pk]
  "semester" TEXT [pk]
  "year" TEXT [pk]
}

Table "time_slot" {
  "time_slot_id" TEXT [pk]
  "day" TEXT [pk]
  "start_hr" TEXT [pk]
  "start_min" TEXT [pk]
  "end_hr" TEXT
  "end_min" TEXT
}



Ref: "course"."dept_name" > "department"."dept_name"

Ref: "instructor"."dept_name" > "department"."dept_name"

Ref: "section"."building" > "classroom"."building"

Ref: "section"."room_number" > "classroom"."room_number"

Ref: "section"."course_id" > "course"."course_id"

Ref: "teaches"."ID" > "instructor"."ID"

Ref: "teaches"."course_id" > "section"."course_id"

Ref: "teaches"."sec_id" > "section"."sec_id"

Ref: "teaches"."semester" > "section"."semester"

Ref: "teaches"."year" > "section"."year"

Ref: "student"."dept_name" > "department"."dept_name"

Ref: "takes"."ID" > "student"."ID"

Ref: "takes"."course_id" > "section"."course_id"

Ref: "takes"."sec_id" > "section"."sec_id"

Ref: "takes"."semester" > "section"."semester"

Ref: "takes"."year" > "section"."year"

Ref: "advisor"."s_ID" > "student"."ID"

Ref: "advisor"."i_ID" > "instructor"."ID"

Ref: "prereq"."prereq_id" > "course"."course_id"

Ref: "prereq"."course_id" > "course"."course_id"
